answer: Age in the trust hierarchy is bought with per-identity verified output rather than with elapsed time, so an operator cannot batch his accounts through a queue and must run each one through genuine, individually verified work. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The mirror is the attested output, the gale the stranger who checks it, and the willow the tier the pair unlocks; the mirror is per identity, the gale cannot be the farm's own, and the willow is what waiting alone cannot buy.
